runner: Actual engine modules through tsx, controlled AudioContext, decoded files, HTMLAudioElement and timers

checks.name: Defaults restore synthesized effects and retain recorded music and nature
Before first gesture: no context, media element or file request
Selected synth effect neither preloads nor fetches its recording
Explicit recording audition waits for decode and leaves the game choice unchanged
Saved per-effect source controls normal game playback in both directions
Epilogue event and theme share one saved choice and report their actual source
Explicit second catalogue effect variant uses the selected decoded URL
Stop invalidates a pending catalogue decode
A newer comparison cancels an older recording still decoding
A/B comparison replaces the previous full track while preserving music and nature layers
Decode failure auditions synth fallback
Runtime decoded-source failure falls back without a false file log
Active music and nature crossfade file to synth and back without resetting scene or weather
45-second ambience loop catalogue sample is six seconds
Selected music catalogue variant streams in full and cleans on natural end
Virtual epilogue reports actual streamed theme and returns to free
Rejected epilogue reports exactly one synth fallback, including virtual event
Failure in outgoing crossfade track cannot replace current scene
Visibility pauses and resumes stream without duplicate source logs
Late rejection from a pre-hide play attempt cannot replace the resumed file stream
A visibility hide/show during pending context resume recovers both context and stream
Media source construction failure releases URL and synthesizes
Recorded music fallback retains its requested choice and does not restart on reconciliation
Undecodable nature fallback retains file choice without repeated crossfades
Decoded nature source failing at playback retains one fallback instead of restarting
Nature crossfades from initial fallback to decoded file loop
Existing volume-only storage preserves volumes and receives the preferred default source profile
Malformed source preferences discard invalid values and unknown cues while retaining valid choices
